# What each helper child does when the harness starts it.
# mode | behaviour
report-environment | names which variables it can see and exits successfully
report-roots | writes one witness file under the root it was given and names it
report-terminal | says whether its standard output is a terminal
flood-streams | writes far more than a pipe holds to both streams
exit-with-code | exits immediately with the code the scenario expects
sleep-forever | never exits on its own and answers nothing
